title: The Noetherian fibre ampleness neighbourhood lemma
statement: Let $f:Z\to S$ be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Assume $S$ is Noetherian, meaning locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Let $L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Z$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], let $s\in S$, and let $Z_s$ be the scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. If the pullback of $L$ to $Z_s$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], then there is an affine open neighbourhood $V\subseteq S$ of $s$ such that $L|_{f^{-1}(V)}$ is ample in the absolute sense.
